alert.title: Set expectations:
alert.text: Kazuhisa wrote he is 'not sure there's much scope for collaboration' but is happy to **exchange views** with Noza if schedules align. Email **khiramatsu@mfs.com** with a light agenda, Tokyo-friendly times.

header.source_line: Lead added to Streak on Nov 9, 2026 by Juliana R. Source: LinkedIn messaging (as Steve).

grade.headline: **Global asset manager** with strong channels; Kazuhisa has given **media interviews** on long-term investing in Japan.
grade.detail: MFS publishes research and insights widely. Follower counts to be confirmed.

snapshot.label: Company
snapshot.value: MFS Investment Management (Boston), about **US$600 billion** AUM; Japan entity **MIMKK** serves institutional and retail investors

snapshot.label: His role
snapshot.value: **Representative Director** of MFS Japan; long-term active management advocate (Keio University alumnus)

snapshot.label: Finance Montréal ICP
snapshot.value: **#3 Asset managers** — fit: **low** for Japan itself. MFS has a Canadian entity (MFS Investment Management Canada); any Montreal decision sits in **Boston/Toronto**, not Tokyo.

best_match.name: Noza Mutalova
best_match.reason: Kazuhisa agreed to meet Noza for an exchange of views.

items: **No shared employer, school or contact verified.**
Both care about **long-term institutional investing** (Quebec's pension funds are major global investors).

lead_with.title: An exchange, not a pitch
lead_with.text: Share how **Quebec pension funds** and global managers use Montreal; ask how MFS organises global operations.

lead_with.title: A location option, not a partnership
lead_with.text: Finance Montréal helps financial firms **place teams in Montreal**. The question is whether any **operations, risk, compliance, data or support** work linked to their business could sit there.

lead_with.title: New York hours at about half the cost
lead_with.text: Montreal is in the **New York time zone**. A Finance Montréal-commissioned Boyd Company 2026 study puts a 150-FTE financial support operation at about **US$18.9M/yr in Montreal vs US$35.3M in New York**.

person.name: Kazuhisa Hiramatsu
person.text: **Representative Director, MFS Investment Management (Japan)** for two decades of his career. Graduate of **Keio University**. Publicly focused on long-term active management and Japan's 'stagnant household assets'.

company.text: MFS Investment Management is a Boston-based global active asset manager. MFS Investment Management K.K. is its Japanese institutional and investment-trust business, a subsidiary of MFS Institutional Advisors.

history.text: Kazuhisa replied: 'I'm not sure there's much scope for collaboration, but if Noza is simply looking to exchange views and information, I'd be happy to meet if schedules align.' He gave **khiramatsu@mfs.com** (Nov 5).

social.note: Mention his view on long-term investing; it's his public theme.

talking_points: How does MFS organise **global operations** between Boston, London, Toronto and Asia?
Does MFS's Canadian entity have any **Montreal** footprint?
What does he see Japanese asset managers doing in **North America**?
Would he point Noza to the right person at **MFS Boston or Canada**?

attention.title: He is skeptical.
attention.text: Keep it an **exchange of views**; no hard pitch.

attention.title: Time zone.
attention.text: Tokyo is **14 hours ahead** of Montreal.
